title: Pokemon TCG Card Nymble 014/182 S&V Paradox Rift Reverse Holo NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the Grass attribute and is a Basic stage card with a HP of 50. The card is from the Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift set and has a Reverse Holo finish, making it a valuable addition to any collection. 

The card's creature type is Abnormal, Insect, and Beast, and it has an Attack/Power of 30. It was manufactured by Nintendo in 2023 and is in English language. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and features artwork by Kouki Saitou. This card is perfect for collectors and players of the Pokémon TCG game.
